description: This file contains unit tests for the media pipeline IPC callback handling in the Rialto client, including tests for playback state, network state, and QoS notifications, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaPipelineIpcCallbackTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for media pipeline IPC callback tests, inheriting from MediaPipelineIpcTestBase, setting up mock environment for IPC callback tests.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates media pipeline IPC.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment, destroys media pipeline IPC.

methods.name: NotifyPlaybackState
methods.description: Test that a playback state update over IPC is forwarded to the client.

methods.name: InvalidSessionIdPlaybackState
methods.description: Test that an event with an invalid session id is ignored for playback state updates.

methods.name: NotifyNetworkState
methods.description: Test that a network state update over IPC is forwarded to the client.

methods.name: InvalidSessionIdNetworkState
methods.description: Test that an event with an invalid session id is ignored for network state updates.

methods.name: NotifyQos
methods.description: Test that a QoS notification over IPC is forwarded to the client.

methods.name: InvalidSessionIdQos
methods.description: Test that an event with an invalid session id is ignored for QoS updates.
